cast.name: Darrow
cast.look: A 16-year-old Red miner boy from the mines of Mars, lean and wiry, dark hair cropped short, sun-darkened skin streaked with red mine dust, a ragged rust-red work overall with the sleeves torn off.

cast.name: Eo
cast.look: A young Red woman, Darrow's wife, slender, long dark hair tied back, a worn grey-red wrap dress and a dusty shawl, a steady and watchful face.

cast.name: Titus
cast.look: A Gold student of the Institute, tall and broad, golden-blond hair cut close, a gilded and high-collared dark uniform with bright gold trim, a cold and proud expression.

cast.name: Julian
cast.look: A Gold young man, slender and pale, soft-faced, neatly combed pale-gold hair, a pale cream gilded tunic, gentle and uncertain eyes.

cast.name: Dan
cast.look: A Gold guard, heavyset and hard-faced, close-cropped dark hair, a black armoured uniform with a brass chest plate, the immediate boot on the Red's neck.

cast.name: Dancer
cast.look: An older Red rebel leader, wiry and scarred, a shaved head, a dusty brown long coat, a tough steady stare, the one who says the Reds are nation breakers.

cast.name: Narrator
cast.look: The narrating voice of the two hosts, never shown on screen.
